name: Residence Permit -- Student Category

qualifying_event.description: A non-citizen admitted to a Botswana educational institution and wishing to stay beyond the visitation period applies for a Residence Permit under the student category.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Admission letter from a Botswana educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of admission letter from a Botswana educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a Botswana educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicants over 18 must apply individually and secure a supporter's commitment.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in source; processing takes 30 working days
